user.title: Set up UK Fuel Finder
user.description:
Enter your Fuel Finder API credentials from https://www.developer.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk

Give this location a name (e.g. "Home" or "Office") so you can tell it apart if you set up more than one. You'll also need your Client ID, Client Secret, location (latitude/longitude), search radius, and how often to check for price updates (5-1440 minutes; default 15 matches API refresh rate).

Optionally, add a free OpenRouteService API key (from https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/signup) to also get driving distance to each station, not just straight-line distance. Leave blank to skip this - everything else works the same either way.
